data.one_liner: A Material Design text field with single and multi-selection searchable dropdown options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DropDownTextField widget that acts as a Material Design text field while allowing users to select single or multiple values from a custom dropdown list. It features built-in search functionality, clear options, checkboxes, and dedicated controllers for single or multi-value management.
use_when: You need a text field combined with a dropdown selection in a Flutter form.
You require searchable dropdown items for single selection.
You need multi-selection dropdowns with checkbox support.
avoid_when: You need a standard dropdown button without a text field input interface.
You require complex custom form builders beyond simple drop-down inputs.
strengths: Supports both single and multi-selection dropdowns.
Includes built-in search capability for single-selection dropdowns.
Highly customizable UI properties including radius, icons, and text styles.
weaknesses: Search option is currently available only for single selection dropdowns.
data.minimal_example:
DropDownTextField(
  clearIcon: Icons.clear,
  dropdownRadius: 12,
  dropDownList: [
    DropDownValueModel(name: 'Name 1', value: "value1"),
    DropDownValueModel(name: 'Name 2', value: "value2"),
  ],
  onChanged: (val) {},
)
